title: Nice Nutty Jamaican Chicken Pilaf
description: A festive Jamaican dish featuring genmaicha and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, cooked in a papillote for a resinous and bouncy texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the chicken, genmaicha tea, brown rice, scotch bonnet peppers, onion, garlic, thyme, allspice, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Mix well to combine, making sure the chicken is coated with the spice mixture.
Cut a piece of parchment paper into a large square, about 12 inches per side.
Place the chicken and rice mixture in the center of the parchment paper, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the parchment paper over the filling, creating a papillote, and press the edges together to seal.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the papillote from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the Nice Nutty Jamaican Chicken Pilaf hot, garnished with fresh thyme and scotch bonnet peppers.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
